Can the unpopular Democrats make themselves more popular than the unpopular president? Today, Explained host Sean Rameswaram asks Vox’s senior politics correspondent Andrew Prokop about what Democrats can do even if they win back the House and maybe the Senate. Watch the full conversation here on our YouTube channel.
